# devin_sessions (Data Source)

Lists the sessions of an organization, with optional filters. Sessions are read-only through this data source; use the API to create or message them.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) Organization ID.

### Optional

- `automation_ids` (Set of String) Only return sessions created by these automations.
- `category` (String) Only return sessions assigned this use-case category.
- `created_after` (Number) Only return sessions created after this time (Unix seconds).
- `created_before` (Number) Only return sessions created before this time (Unix seconds).
- `devin_id` (String) Only return the session with this Devin ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Only return archived (true) or unarchived (false) sessions.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of sessions to return. Sessions are ordered most recently updated first, so a limit keeps the newest ones. Without a limit all matching sessions are fetched, which can be slow and produce large state on big organizations.
- `origins` (Set of String) Only return sessions created through these origins.
- `parent_session_id` (String) Only return child sessions of this parent session.
- `playbook_id` (String) Only return sessions started from this playbook.
- `repo_names` (Set of String) Only return sessions attached to these repositories (e.g. owner/repo).
- `schedule_id` (String) Only return sessions started from this schedule.
- `service_user_ids` (Set of String) Only return sessions created by these service users.
- `session_ids` (Set of String) Only return these session IDs.
- `statuses` (Set of String) Only return sessions in these statuses (new, claimed, running, resuming, suspended, exit, error). Applied client-side: the API does not filter by status, so matching sessions are selected from the fetched pages.
- `tags` (Set of String) Only return sessions carrying these tags.
- `updated_after` (Number) Only return sessions updated after this time (Unix seconds).
- `updated_before` (Number) Only return sessions updated before this time (Unix seconds).
- `user_ids` (Set of String) Only return sessions created by these users.

### Read-Only

- `sessions` (Attributes List) Sessions matching the filters, most recently updated first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sessions))

<a id="nestedatt--sessions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sessions`

Read-Only:

- `acus_consumed` (Number) ACUs consumed by the session.
- `automation_id` (String) Automation that created the session, if any.
- `category` (String) Assigned use-case category, when categorisation has run.
- `child_session_ids` (List of String) Sessions spawned by this session.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation time (Unix seconds).
- `devin_mode` (String) Devin agent mode the session runs (e.g. normal, fast, swe-2-high).
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the session is archived.
- `on_demand_usage` (Number) On-demand (overage) spend in USD, excluding child sessions. Only populated for Teams plans.
- `org_id` (String) Owning organization. Null for detached sessions owned by the creator's account.
- `origin` (String) Origin the session was created through (e.g. webapp, api, automation).
- `parent_session_id` (String) Parent session that spawned this session, if any.
- `playbook_id` (String) Playbook the session was started from, if any.
- `pull_requests` (Attributes List) Pull requests produced by the session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sessions--pull_requests))
- `service_user_id` (String) Service user that created the session.
- `session_id` (String) Session ID.
- `status` (String) Session status: new, claimed, running, resuming, suspended, exit, or error.
- `status_detail` (String) Additional detail about the current status (e.g. working, waiting_for_user, finished, inactivity).
- `structured_output` (String) Validated structured output from the session, as a JSON string.
- `subcategory` (String) Assigned subcategory display name.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags attached to the session.
- `title` (String) Session title.
- `updated_at` (Number) Last update time (Unix seconds).
- `url` (String) Session URL in the Devin web app.
- `user_id` (String) User that created the session.

### Nested Schema for `sessions.pull_requests`

Read-Only:

- `pr_state` (String) Pull request state (e.g. open, merged, closed).
- `pr_url` (String) Pull request URL.
